27	class ClientRegistry:
28	    """Thread-safe registry of connected WebSocket clients with channel support."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self):
31	        self._clients: Dict[str, ServerConnection] = {}
32	        self._subscriptions: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
33	        self._lock = Lock()
34	
35	    def add(self, client_id: str, connection: ServerConnection) -> None:
36	        """Add a client to the registry."""
37	        with self._lock:
38	            self._clients[client_id] = connection
39	            self._subscriptions[client_id] = set()
40	
41	    def remove(self, client_id: str) -> None:
42	        """Remove a client from the registry."""
43	        with self._lock:
44	            self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
45	            self._subscriptions.pop(client_id, None)
46	
47	    def get(self, client_id: str) -> ServerConnection | None:
48	        """Get a client connection by ID."""
49	        with self._lock:
50	            return self._clients.get(client_id)
51	
52	    def get_all(self) -> Dict[str, ServerConnection]:
53	        """Get a copy of all clients."""
54	        with self._lock:
55	            return dict(self._clients)
56	
57	    def count(self) -> int:
58	        """Get the number of connected clients."""
59	        with self._lock:
60	            return len(self._clients)
61	
62	    def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
63	        """Subscribe a client to a channel."""
64	        with self._lock:
65	            if client_id in self._subscriptions:
66	                self._subscriptions[client_id].add(channel)
67	
68	    def unsubscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
69	        """Unsubscribe a client from a channel."""
70	        with self._lock:
71	            if client_id in self._subscriptions:
72	                self._subscriptions[client_id].discard(channel)
73	
74	    def get_subscriptions(self, client_id: str) -> Set[str]:
75	        """Get all channels a client is subscribed to."""
76	        with self._lock:
77	            return set(self._subscriptions.get(client_id, set()))
78	
79	    def get_channel_subscribers(self, channel: str) -> Set[str]:
80	        """Get all client IDs subscribed to a channel."""
81	        with self._lock:
82	            subscribers = set()
83	            for client_id, channels in self._subscriptions.items():
84	                if channel in channels:
85	                    subscribers.add(client_id)
86	            return subscribers
87	
88	    def get_all_channels(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
89	        """Get all active channels and their subscriber counts."""
90	        with self._lock:
91	            channels: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
92	            for client_id, subs in self._subscriptions.items():
93	                for channel in subs:
94	                    if channel not in channels:
95	                        channels[channel] = set()
96	                    channels[channel].add(client_id)
97	            return {channel: len(subscribers) for channel, subscribers in channels.items()}

104	        self.type = msg_type

145	                "system",

147	            )

154	
155	                    if msg.type == "subscribe":

165	                    elif msg.type == "broadcast":

168	                        )
169	                    elif msg.type == "direct":
170	                        target_id = msg.payload.get("target_id")
171	                        if target_id:
172	                            await self.send_direct(target_id, msg)
173	                    elif msg.type == "system":
174	                        await self.broadcast(msg)
175	                    else:
176	                        channel = msg.payload.get("channel")
177	                        if channel:
178	                            await self.broadcast_to_channel(channel, msg)
179	                        else:
180	                            await self.broadcast(msg)
181	
182	                except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
183	                    logger.error(f"Invalid JSON from {client_id}: {e}")
184	                    error_msg = NotificationMessage(
185	                        "system",
186	                        {"action": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON format"}
187	                    )
188	                    await websocket.send(error_msg.to_json())
189	
190	        except websockets.exceptions.ConnectionClosed:
191	            pass
192	        finally:
193	            self.clients.remove(client_id)
194	            logger.info(f"Client {client_id} disconnected. Total clients: {self.clients.count()}")
195	
196	    async def broadcast(self, message: NotificationMessage) -> None:
197	        """Broadcast a message to all connected clients."""
198	        clients = self.clients.get_all()
199	        if not clients:
200	            logger.debug("No clients to broadcast to")
201	            return
202	
203	        message_json = message.to_json()
204	        tasks = []
205	
206	        for client_id, connection in clients.items():
207	            tasks.append(self._send_safe(connection, message_json, client_id))
208	
209	        if tasks:
210	            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
211	
212	    async def broadcast_to_channel(self, channel: str, message: NotificationMessage) -> None:
213	        """Broadcast a message to all clients subscribed to a channel."""
214	        subscribers = self.clients.get_channel_subscribers(channel)
215	        if not subscribers:
216	            logger.debug(f"No subscribers for channel {channel}")
217	            return
218	
219	        message_json = message.to_json()

class MessagePersistence:
    """SQLite-based message persistence for history."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = None):
        self.db_path = db_path or os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "messages.db")
        self.lock = Lock()
        self.init_db()

    def init_db(self) -> None:
        """Initialize the messages table."""
        with self.get_connection() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages ("
                "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
                "  channel TEXT NOT NULL,"
                "  type TEXT NOT NULL,"
                "  payload TEXT NOT NULL,"
                "  timestamp TEXT NOT NULL"
                ")"
            )
            conn.commit()

    def get_connection(self):
        """Get a database connection."""
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return conn

    def store_message(self, channel: str, msg_type: str, payload: dict, timestamp: str) -> int:
        """Store a message in the database."""
        with self.lock:
            with self.get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO messages (channel, type, payload, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (channel, msg_type, json.dumps(payload), timestamp),
                )
                conn.commit()
                return cursor.lastrowid

    def get_messages(self, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> list:
        """Retrieve messages from the database."""
        with self.get_connection() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, channel, type, payload, timestamp FROM messages "
                "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
                (limit, offset),
            ).fetchall()
            return [
                {
                    "id": row["id"],
                    "channel": row["channel"],
                    "type": row["type"],
                    "payload": json.loads(row["payload"]),
                    "timestamp": row["timestamp"],
                }
                for row in rows
            ]

        """Get total message count."""
        with self.get_connection() as conn:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM messages").fetchone()
            return row["count"]

async def redis_subscribe(self) -> None:
        """Subscribe to Redis pub/sub channels for distributed messaging."""
        if not self.redis:
            return

        pubsub = self.redis.pubsub()
        self.pubsub = pubsub
        await pubsub.subscribe("broadcast", "channel:*")
        logger.info("Subscribed to Redis pub/sub channels")

        try:
            async for message in pubsub.listen():
                if message["type"] == "message":
                    try:
                        channel = message["channel"]
                        if isinstance(channel, bytes):
                            channel = channel.decode()
                        data = message["data"]
                        if isinstance(data, bytes):
                            data = data.decode()

                        msg = NotificationMessage.from_json(data)
                        logger.info(f"Received from Redis on {channel}: {msg.type}")

                        if channel == "broadcast":
                            await self.broadcast_to_clients(msg)
                        elif channel.startswith("channel:"):
                            channel_name = channel[8:]
                            await self.broadcast_to_channel_clients(channel_name, msg)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Error processing Redis message: {e}")
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            await pubsub.unsubscribe()
            await pubsub.close()

    async def broadcast_to_clients(self, message: NotificationMessage) -> None:
        """Send message to all locally connected clients."""
        clients = self.clients.get_all()
        if not clients:
            return

        message_json = message.to_json()
        tasks = []

        for client_id, connection in clients.items():
            tasks.append(self._send_safe(connection, message_json, client_id))

        if tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    async def broadcast_to_channel_clients(self, channel: str, message: NotificationMessage) -> None:
        """Send message to locally connected clients subscribed to a channel."""
        subscribers = self.clients.get_channel_subscribers(channel)
        if not subscribers:
            return

        message_json = message.to_json()
        tasks = []
        clients = self.clients.get_all()

        for client_id in subscribers:
            connection = clients.get(client_id)
            if connection:
                tasks.append(self._send_safe(connection, message_json, client_id))
